Interface RouteConditionContext

All Known Implementing Classes:
RouteConditionContext.Fallback
@Internal public interface RouteConditionContext
What the router asks the server for a request, to evaluate the conditions of a route on the host, the client address and the time of the request, see RouteCondition.Host, RouteCondition.RemoteAddress and RouteCondition.TimeWindow. The HTTP server provides a bean that resolves them with its host and client address resolvers and its configuration; without one, the router reads the Host header, the peer of the connection and the system clock, see fallback().

5.3.0
